title: Bounded Rationality & Cognitive Biases
summary: Exploring how cognitive limits and heuristics shape human decision-making and modern everyday choices.

key_vocabulary.example: In complex economic choices, bounded rationality forces consumers to select satisfactory rather than optimal solutions.
An availability heuristic makes people overestimate the likelihood of memorable events.

discussion_prompts: Have you ever made an impulse decision based on limited information that turned out surprisingly well?
How can leaders mitigate cognitive bias when making high-stakes strategic choices under pressure?
